actionAdapters.when: 需要按冻结的 Android 依赖图执行 EDM4U Force Resolve 并核验受管输出时

allow: ProjectSettings/AndroidResolverDependencies.xml produced by the confirmed EDM4U Force Resolve
Assets/GeneratedLocalRepo/** produced and managed by EDM4U
Assets/Plugins/Android/** files and templates explicitly tracked by EDM4U resolution state
exact frozen gpsr-labelled asset deletion/replacement set and generated meta files
exact frozen local Maven AAR/SRCAAR copy, associated POM and PluginImporter targets on the template resolution branch
Java/Gradle execution, Maven downloads, host caches and Android SDK package installation only when their exact targets are frozen and confirmed

exact frozen Library import registration, two empty Search property DB/.st pairs, bounded GUID merge temporary files and observed four-array transaction append; later idempotent maintenance of only these derived caches
native SpeedTree9Importer_MaterialSettings dependency prefix maintenance only with no matching current static methods, st9/spm inputs or non-target artifact dependencies
exact audited editor memory/UI effects and at most nine already existing color EditorPrefs keys whose normal serialized values are identical; complete pending consumer snapshot required
same-byte GvhProjectSettings.xml persistence and the exact frozen GooglePlayServices.UseJetifier=True system preference materialization on the normal true branch
standard Unity assetPostProcessorsUsage v2 under its existing enabled state: importActionId, methodName, duration_sec and invocationCount; no delivery claim

only four exact UI Toolkit engine-owned rendering roles on frozen existing panels may rebuild after execution; field ownership, audited module identity, input resources and original dirty flags stay validated; all original object rows remain in evidence
deny: Packages/manifest.json, Packages/packages-lock.json, registry or resolved package contents
manual deletion or editing outside the exact EDM4U-managed file set
private Maven repository URL, userinfo, query token, credential or raw secret in Plan, Receipt, log or report
business Gradle/Manifest customization not tracked by EDM4U, Config, Scene, Prefab or business source
HybridCLR generation, Bundle or Player build, device installation, vendor dashboard, external writes outside the exact resolution plan, Git commit or push

requiredFor: current resolution settings and templates, ordered local Maven sources, exact gpsr deletion set, Java/Gradle/SDK identity and external download/cache/install targets
the exact frozen EDM4U dependency graph digest and complete managed write set
Force Resolve deletion or replacement of existing EDM4U-managed files and GeneratedLocalRepo output
any changed activeBuildTarget, dependency graph, managed path or execution entry
UPM change, build, device installation, credential use, external write, delete outside managed outputs, Git commit or push
confirmation.rule: 确认只绑定当前 Android Target、完整依赖图摘要和 EDM4U 精确受管写入集；任何图、路径、平台或入口漂移后旧确认失效。

evidence: 当前真实回调派发、源码/DLL 指纹、自然调度、模板输入与非目标保护完整满足时 Plan 可 ready；未知分支具体 blocked，不修改设置或主动消费队列造绿；缺完整刷新证据的旧回执或域重载最高 partial
冻结及执行前复核的 activeBuildTarget=Android、非空 EDM4U 依赖图和 SHA-256
不含私有仓库原值的 repository SHA-256 摘要与精确受管写入集
ResolveSync 明确成功标记；异常、失败或 domain reload 后未自动重放
AndroidResolverDependencies.xml 的 package/files/settings 与冻结图一致
全部 EDM4U 受管文件、GeneratedLocalRepo 与 Artifact SHA-256 的 Verify 证据
未执行 UPM、Gradle/Player 构建、设备、厂商后台、凭据、外部发布或 Git 的边界说明
正规场景回调 ResolveSync(false, true) 与 Force Resolve 分开：完整包、gpsr 路径、15 项当前解析设置与状态一致后仍须另验产物 SHA-256；不修改自动解析或私有场景计数
Plan 未完整冻结正规输入、副作用或外部目标时准确 blocked；不因 Descriptor 或静态检查通过声称可执行
模板支路 POM 完整预期字节 SHA-256 与实际结果一致；未删除既有目标保留全部非 packaging 内容；只检查 packaging 不构成验收
场景和 Force Resolve 复用同一无弹窗工具链冻结：JDK 二进制及 release 摘要、版本、工作目录与额外 Java 参数检查；不改配置或环境造绿
严格已审 EDM4U 1.2.188 Report 无 HTTP 或持久上报队列；自然全局关闭或系统同意已请求且无进行中窗口，实例/字段/偏好/持久配置摘要前后相同；未初始化或域重载身份不能继承。
当前可执行支路仅已有模板和本地 SRCAAR/POM；只读 Java 版本检查；未执行 Gradle、下载或 SDK 安装，不将正常内部能力缺口归为用户环境原因
正规 Resolve 只调用一次，自有观察器只记录实际四数组并等待自然 Editor update；写后失败、取消或超时保留完整 partial 且不重放
Search 联合只读锁下空缓存逻辑物化、稳定 DB/.st 摘要与真实有序事务增量；允许精确派生缓存后续幂等维护，不证明所有 discarded Task 退出
Plan 时完整 pending 队列、固定九键同值物化和精确 UI/IDE 派生效果与原值/预期；其余文件/原有对象脏状态/场景/选择不变
UseJetifier 正规 true setter 的精确系统键预期与项目持久文件同字节结果；其他解析设置不变
源码编译包的精确身份维护须匹配当前唯一加载类型、磁盘 DLL/MVID、实际编译映射及回调分支；完整路径拒绝无点 shadergraph/shadersubgraph 后缀及其 meta/父目录，动态状态仍逐次检查
旧配置迁移回调仅接纳无 asset 完整域、精确编译归属、真实正常 update 见证及 queued=false；原 Plan State/观察器同域回调/调度摘要一致才继承原见证，Verify 反序列化回执另核真实 update 栈；仍拒绝迁移/初始化重入，不调用、清除或推进迁移，历史迁移结果仅纳非目标基线
仅该下游模块的已审完整 DLL/MVID 由 android-refresh-compiled-identity.json 非代码 reference 提供；严格双字段/512B边界，不自动采纳实际 DLL，当前身份必须进入原冻结摘要并在写前/写后重核
UIR动态Atlas页的复制材质须经页m_Blitter.m_BlitMaterial精确字段链、Shader与原dirty验证，不按名称泛化放行；UIR前后角色图绑定各自Snapshot/Receipt摘要；写前精确相等，写后仅精确owner角色重建，面板根/输入/dirty保持；旧null字段保留旧摘要与原严格对象比较，不补造历史owner-map或升级partial。
